statement: The inspected xpad and SDL sources do not establish that FF_RUMBLE callback support on uinput/UHID automatically creates a Linux xpad LED-class node or routes effects to motors; that requires an explicit virtual FF handler and separate LED realization. No definitive Steam FF/LED acceptance on virtual Xbox360 UHID is captured here.
